story.title: Our Journey
story.content: Tissu Dubai was born from a deep passion for beautiful fabrics and Moroccan craftsmanship. Since our founding in Casablanca, we have strived to offer an exclusive selection of premium fabrics that elevate the most prestigious creations.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.content: We believe that every creation deserves the finest fabric. That is why we travel the world to select the most refined, noble, and beautiful materials, to offer our Moroccan and international clientele a unique experience.

quality.title: Commitment to Quality
quality.content: Every fabric we offer undergoes a rigorous selection process. We work exclusively with trusted suppliers and manufacturers renowned for their excellence.

craftsmanship.title: Moroccan Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.content: Morocco possesses a rich and ancient textile heritage. We contribute to preserving this legacy by offering fabrics that honor traditions while embracing contemporary trends.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Find quick answers to your questions

questions.question: What types of fabrics do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer a wide range of premium fabrics for traditional Moroccan clothing: caftans, djellabas, takchitas, as well as fabrics for bespoke creations. Our collections include silks, brocades, velvets, luxury cotton, and more.

questions.question: Do you sell by the meter?
questions.answer: Yes, all our fabrics are sold by the meter. Most of our fabrics are available in standard widths from 1.40m to 3 meters, depending on the reference.

questions.question: How can I check fabric availability?
questions.answer: You can check availability directly on our website, or contact us by phone or WhatsApp for immediate confirmation. Our team is available to provide any information.

questions.question: How do I place an order?
questions.answer: To place an order, simply contact us via WhatsApp with the fabric reference, desired color, and quantity. We will confirm availability and pricing, and arrange the next steps.

questions.question: Where are you located?
questions.answer: Our store is located in the heart of Casablanca. You can find our exact address and opening hours on the 'Our Store' page.

questions.question: Do you offer samples?
questions.answer: Yes, we can send samples so you can see and feel the fabrics before ordering. Contact us via WhatsApp to learn more.

questions.question: Do you deliver within Morocco?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer delivery throughout Morocco. Contact us for more details on delivery options and rates.
